verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs show a keyboard-driven launcher: press the Super key and type to search. That covers the launcher half of the story, but nothing in the pack documents hotkeys for window management or keyboard-only operation of the whole system. missing for 10: documented window-management and system hotkeys, evidence that the entire desktop can be driven without a mouse, configurable shortcuts, independent or hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only workflows.
